About the challenge

Your starting point for a more practical digital journey.

The Digital Growth Challenge is a 30 day introduction to the opportunities, skills and thinking behind digital entrepreneurship. It is designed to make complex ideas easier to understand and give you useful direction as you explore the online space.

Throughout November, daily written lessons will be shared in the learning communities at 8:00 PM West Africa Time. Each lesson is intended to provide useful knowledge, examples and practical ideas you can begin applying.

Explore the Course
What you will learn

Understand the skills behind digital opportunity.

The programme moves from foundational knowledge to practical areas of building and growing an online business.

Digital Entrepreneurship

Understand the digital economy, business models and how online opportunities create value.

Opportunity Discovery

Recognise problems, audiences and needs that can become meaningful business opportunities.

Digital Marketing

Learn the fundamentals of positioning, content, audience development and customer acquisition.

Digital Products

Explore how knowledge and skills can be organised into useful digital products.

Content and Community

Understand how content and relationships can support trust and audience growth.

Sales and Conversion

Explore customer journeys, offers, sales communication and conversion fundamentals.

Online Business Systems

Learn why processes, delivery and customer experience matter as a business grows.

Execution and Growth

Turn learning into action through experimentation, reflection and consistent improvement.

The 30 day journey

Four weeks. One clear direction.

Each week builds on the previous one, helping participants move from understanding the space to thinking about practical execution.

Days 1 to 7

Understand the Digital Space

Digital entrepreneurship, online opportunities, business models and the foundations of value creation.

Days 8 to 14

Develop Valuable Skills

Digital marketing, content, audience understanding, positioning and communication.

Days 15 to 21

Create and Monetise

Digital products, offers, customer journeys, sales and practical monetisation principles.

Days 22 to 30

Build and Grow

Systems, execution, consistency, common mistakes and a practical growth mindset.

Daily lesson topics and supporting materials will be shared with participants throughout the programme.

About me

From figuring things out alone to helping others grow.

My journey into the digital space began when I was 18. Like many people starting out, I did not have a clear vision, a personal coach, a mentor or a structured direction. I had to learn through exploration, experimentation and practical experience.

Along the way, I made mistakes. I tried things that did not work, learned valuable lessons and gradually discovered how digital skills, online business and consistent execution can create meaningful opportunities.

I have created more than 15 digital products and generated over ₦10 Million in cumulative revenue from online activities. I am the founder of Izu AI Academy and cofounder of Bluedemy and Marizu Academy.

I have connected with and taught people across different countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Ghana, Cameroon and Togo. I have also taught learners in different languages.

My focus is helping people understand practical digital skills, create value and approach digital entrepreneurship with clarity and purpose.
